title: Please stop
body:
I have “In-app ratings & reviews” disabled, stop spamming me every week or so to review it and please don’t spam paying users with your “special offers” of your other apps as notifications inside the app.

Otherwise it is well done and works exceptionally well, much better than other options available, except that, if you have Touch ID enabled and had the app open before locking the phone, when you open it next time it will momentarily peek inside.

Would be nice to know on which days I left a comment on the calendar tab.
author: Nevanoxx
